title: POLYMETER: every track's length and speed on one page
description: A master page (FUNC + LFO, PLY): tracks 1-8 as lanes as long as their lengths, with moving playheads; knobs for the active track's length and speed, the pattern's scale mode and master length, and one-turn polymeter presets (16, DWN, PRM, 3V4). Edits the pattern itself, as the stock scale menu does, so it saves with the pattern.
author: Cere, made with Claude
